purpose: Recovery index for the archived fixed test sample; not a record of the original random draws or an inferred random seed.
sampling_description: Six source groups, 200 records per group; archived order preserved.
random_seed_status: Original test sampler did not specify a seed. This recovery does not infer or replace one.
matching_method: Compare saved raw sample sentence plus canonicalized full XML with all original attributes retained, restricted to its verified 200-record source-group block.
location_assignment: For indistinguishable full raw pairs in one group, consume unused locations in sorted filename/document order. This is a valid recovery mapping and does not assert which equivalent original position was randomly drawn.

normalization.method: Extract ju in document order; collect stripped text and tail segments; serialize/reparse ju; remove all other attributes recursively; remove whitespace between adjacent tags and before self-closing />.
normalization.reference_serialization: JSON ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, CRLF line endings outside strings, no final newline.
